what_likely_happened: An attacker compromised the user workstation WS-ENG-088 and performed a network port scan to map internal services. They then used lateral movement via SMB/Admin shares with the svc_deploy service account to access SRV-APP-03, subsequently reusing credentials across production servers before performing LSASS process memory access on SRV-DB-PROD for privilege escalation.

evidence.finding: Subnet Port Scan Detected on Internal Segment
evidence.detail: Host WS-ENG-088 initiated SYN scan targeting 254 endpoints on 10.0.4.0/24 across ports 22, 135, 445, 3389, 8080

evidence.finding: PsExec Remote Service Execution via Admin Share
evidence.detail: Service installation detected: PSEXESVC created on SRV-APP-03 from source WS-ENG-088 using credential svc_deploy

evidence.finding: Service Account Credential Reuse Across Production Tier
evidence.detail: Account svc_deploy authenticated concurrently across SRV-APP-03, SRV-DB-PROD, and SRV-AUTH-01 within 2 minutes

evidence.finding: Privilege Escalation via Memory Injection & LSASS Access
evidence.detail: Process rundll32.exe opened handle with PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS to lsass.exe on SRV-DB-PROD to dump NTDS / memory secrets

confidence_reason: All events contain fully populated hostnames, valid usernames, specific MITRE techniques, and follow a clear, coherent progression through the attacker kill chain without missing fields or adversarial tampering.

recommended_actions.title: Apply Microsegmentation ACL on Port Scanning Source
recommended_actions.description: Automatically isolated host 10.0.4.88 from internal subnets at core switch layer.

recommended_actions.title: Purge Kerberos TGT & Revoke Service Tickets
recommended_actions.description: Automatically purged Kerberos tickets for svc_deploy across Domain Controllers.

recommended_actions.title: Quarantine Compromised Application Server
recommended_actions.description: Sever network connectivity on SRV-APP-03 to halt remote PsExec payload execution.

recommended_actions.title: Freeze Production Database & Revoke System Privileges
recommended_actions.description: Initiate immutable storage snapshot and restrict access to DB tier to contain LSASS dump.
